board.title: Board
board.subtitle: Everything in flight, in the column its status puts it in.
board.closedWindow: Done and Cancelled show the last {days} days.
board.columnEmptyHint: Drag a card here, or use a card's status menu.
board.hiddenColumnsHint: A retired status keeps a place here while items are still sitting in it. You can move work out of one, but not into it.
board.moveDisabledHint: Only the person who created or owns an item can move it.
board.grabbed: Picked up {title}. Drag it over a column, or press Escape to cancel.
board.dragHint: Drag a card between columns, or use its status menu. With a card focused, the arrow keys move it one column and the number keys send it straight to a column.
board.keyboardHint: No dragging needed. Tab to a card, then use the left and right arrow keys to move it one column at a time, the number keys to send it to a numbered column, or the card's own status menu.
board.emptyHint: Capture something, or widen your filters.
board.errMove: That move didn't stick — the card is back where it was.
